description: Call after each completed step with the state you would need to continue (cursor, ids done, partial results; up to 256 KB JSON). Pro saves it (last 20 per run, kept 30 days). Free watch-only saves nothing and returns would_save: exactly what would have been stored. Never put passwords or API keys in state.

done.description: Optional list of completed item ids, so a resume skips them.

run_id.description: A stable id for this job that survives a crash, e.g. "invoice-import-oct". Use the same id when you restart.

step.description: The step you just finished, e.g. "imported page 3 of 10".

name: save_checkpoint
